construct=R. jostii RHA1 shell; variant_status=wild_type; assembly_symmetry=icosahedral; T_number=1; T_number_basis=other_supported_inference; shell_subunit_count=60; curated_notes=Experimentally reconstituted cognate DypB-loaded WT nanocompartment. The Enc-DypB complex eluted at a retention time 
similar to the encapsulin-only particle and contained both proteins, with a measured encapsulin:DypB molar ratio of 8.6:1. The loaded complex also showed enhanced lignin-degradation activity per mole of DypB. A 60-shell-subunit/6-DypB model was proposed by comparison with T. maritima rather than directly determined for Q0SE23. Jones & Giessen 2021 classify the R. jostii shell as a 60-subunit T=1 encapsulin; icosahedral symmetry, T=1 and 60 shell subunits are therefore recorded here as supported inferences. No loaded-state shell diameter was directly measured.
method: size-exclusion chromatography; SDS-PAGE; UV-vis spectroscopy; activity assay
condition: WT shell disassembled at pH 3.0 in the presence of cognate recombinant DypB and reassembled in vitro at pH 7.4; DypB-loaded
